senses.gloss:
ITA-1.9.3.3.30 śokaḥ शोकः
Grief, sorrow or misery
A state of affliction caused by various determinants (vibhava) such as the death of a loved person, loss of wealth or personal misfortune.

ITA-5.17.6 śokajanyarājayakṣmā शोकजन्यराजयक्ष्मा
Consumption due to excessive grief
A disorder characterized by a constant thoughtful mood; flaccidity/laxity; pallor.

ITA-5.28.6 śokajonmādaḥ शोकजोन्मादः
Psychosis due to grief
A disorder characterized by some or all the following signs and symptoms: a person irrelevantly describing imagined things; improper perception/unconsciousness; singing; laughing; crying suddenly; stupefaction due to improper perception; pallor/paleness; timidity or apathy; fainting repeatedly; weeping and making sounds such as “ha-ha”; dying; overestimating; mind disturbed by sorrow; thinking; alert; doing inappropriate acts.
